title: Redesign homepage with immersive, graphics-heavy 'traveling through a tool shed' experience

requirements.text: Redesign the homepage (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) to feel like an immersive journey “traveling through a tool shed,” using a more life-filled, graphics-heavy layout while preserving the existing primary actions (Browse Tools, Get Started / List a Tool) and authentication-dependent behavior.

quotes: now create a more life filled homepage including more graphics and visuals. Make it such that you feel like you're traveling through a tool shed

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage content is clearly themed as an immersive tool-shed journey (e.g., a sequence of sections that feels like moving through a shed/workshop)

Existing CTA behaviors remain intact: unauthenticated users see Get Started/Sign Up actions calling login; authenticated users see List a Tool navigating to /add-listing; Browse Tools navigates to /browse
Uses substantially more visuals than the current homepage (multiple graphics/illustrations/background elements beyond a single hero image)
Layout is responsive from mobile to desktop and does not overflow or clip key content

requirements.text: Implement a cohesive visual theme for the new homepage that reinforces the tool-shed travel vibe (e.g., warm workshop lighting, wood/metal textures, signage/labels), and apply it consistently across the homepage sections without changing the global app layout (header/footer) behavior.

quotes: create a more life filled homepage including more graphics and visuals
feel like you're traveling through a tool shed

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage styling reads as a unified theme (colors, typography accents, section backgrounds, and visual motifs align)
Does not require edits to immutable paths (e.g., frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/*, frontend/src/components/ui/*)
Header and footer remain functional and readable on top of any new homepage backgrounds (no contrast/accessibility regressions)

requirements.text: Add lightweight, performant visual motion to support the “travel” feeling on the homepage (e.g., parallax-like section transitions, subtle animated floating dust motes/light beams, or animated sign/indicator elements) using CSS/Tailwind-friendly techniques and respecting reduced-motion preferences.

quotes: feel like you're traveling through a tool shed

acceptanceCriteria: Animations are subtle and do not block interaction or navigation
If the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled, animations are reduced/disabled appropriately
No noticeable jank during scroll on modern desktop/mobile browsers (avoid heavy runtime effects)

requirements.text: Integrate newly generated static image assets for the homepage into the app by placing them under frontend/public/assets/generated and referencing them from the homepage implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: All new images are stored as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated
LandingPage renders the new images and they load correctly in the browser (no broken links)

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Do not introduce new backend services or external databases; this request should be achievable with frontend-only changes
Keep all user-facing text in English
nonGoals: Changing backend data models or adding new backend endpoints
Reworking non-homepage pages (browse, listings, profile, messaging) beyond what is necessary to keep navigation consistent
Adding Three.js/R3F scenes unless strictly necessary (prefer lightweight CSS/DOM effects)

required: Tool shed interior corridor/aisle scene with warm workshop lighting, inviting perspective (toolshed-journey-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
Set of workshop/tool-shed themed decorative UI stickers (e.g., labels, tags, caution stripes, bolts) on transparent background (toolshed-ui-stickers.dim_1400x900.png)
Wood plank texture background, subtle and tileable (toolshed-wood-texture.dim_1024x1024.png)
Workbench scene flat-lay banner with tools and materials (workbench-banner.dim_1600x600.png)
edits: Shift the existing hero image to match a more immersive tool shed travel vibe (toolshare-hero.dim_1600x900.png > toolshare-hero-toolshed.dim_1600x900.png)
